evals.prompt: Our odds captures sit in a vendor's managed time-series database at $350 a month. Are we locked in?
evals.expected_output: Prices the part with its hours, tests the swap, and decides.
expectations: Lists the part with seller and monthly cost
Adds the hours it takes to the full cost
Says whether the data can leave in a standard format and names a standard swap with its full cost
Ends with keep, change or stop and an owner, testing any move on a scratch copy

evals.expected_output: Chooses standard parts more than one seller offers, priced in full.
expectations: Lists each part with seller and cost or marked proposals
Counts run hours at a rate
Marks each part standard or one-seller
Routes the live change through tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator on the owner's word
